title: Integrating Assertion Based Verification Methodology

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

body:
## Summary

Introduce Assertion-Based Verification (ABV) using SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) into the existing RTL codebase to catch protocol violations, illegal state transitions, and interface misuse earlier and more systematically than directed testbenches alone.

## Proposed Scope
 * Identify target modules/interfaces for initial rollout (e.g., AXI-Stream interfaces, FIFO/BRAM controllers, clock-domain-crossing points, FSM-heavy blocks)
 * Define a baseline set of reusable assertion patterns (protocol checks, one-hot/FSM legality, no-X propagation, handshake stability)
 * Add concurrent assertions (assert property) for interface protocol compliance
 * Add immediate assertions for combinational/datapath invariants where applicable
 * Bind assertions non-intrusively (e.g., via bind statement or separate checker modules) to avoid polluting synthesizable RTL
 * Integrate assertion results into existing simulation regression flow (pass/fail reporting)
 * Document naming conventions and coding guidelines for assertions
### Out of Scope (for this issue)
* Formal property verification (model checking) — may be a follow-up
* Coverage-driven verification (functional coverage groups) — separate effort
## Acceptance Criteria
At least one representative module has SVA-based checks bound and passing in simulation
Assertions fire correctly on an intentionally injected bug (sanity check that they work)
Guidelines/README section added describing how to add new assertions going forward
